description: caveman-mcp is the agent-side recovery tool (mcp__caveman__caveman_retrieve) caveman-proxy requires before it will compress streaming/subscription traffic such as Claude Code. Package it from the bin-v2.0.2 release, the exact pin of caveman-proxy (they share the ccr.db format), and add it to llm-toolchain.
title: Package caveman-mcp 2.0.2 and add it to llm-toolchain
